integrity: Exact oriented fixed-face proof and reproducible finite verifier; published nonequivariant homotopy theorem expressly credited.
scientific_limitations: Complete rational character of the natural rim dihedral group, not an integral equivariant module or equivariant homotopy decomposition. Finite verifier samples corroborate but do not prove the infinite result. Closest public scientific statements and proofs for cycle matching complexes and wheel discrete-Morse complexes were inspected; equivalent work in unindexed literature remains possible.
title: The full \(D_n\) character of wheel-graph matching homology
